user.title: Connect to Sprout Track
user.description: Create an API key in Sprout Track under **Settings → Admin → Integrations**. It needs the *read* scope for the sensors and *write* for the buttons and actions.

data_description.url: The address you open Sprout Track at in the browser, with http or https and the port
data_description.api_key: Starts with st_live_ and is shown only once when it is created
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed HTTPS certificate

reauth_confirm.title: New API key for Sprout Track
reauth_confirm.description: Sprout Track at {url} no longer accepts the API key (revoked, expired or without the read scope). Create a new one under **Settings → Admin → Integrations**.

data_description.url: The address you open Sprout Track at in the browser, with http or https and the port
data_description.api_key: Starts with st_live_ and is shown only once when it is created

error.cannot_connect: No Sprout Track answered at this address. Check address and port.
error.invalid_auth: Sprout Track does not accept this API key.
error.invalid_url: Enter the full address, starting with http:// or https://
error.https_required: Sprout Track only allows plain http:// for private IP addresses and localhost. Use the IP address or an https:// address.
error.read_scope_required: This API key lacks the read scope.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This Sprout Track family is already set up.
abort.wrong_family: This API key belongs to a different family than the one set up here.

data_description.scan_interval: Each update takes one request plus one per baby; Sprout Track allows 60 per minute per key.
